thread:
Maya: Proposal to move SIEM raw S3 exports from 400d -> 90d to shrink PII blast radius and cut costs. Need a clear preserve/unlock runbook for IR/legal.
Priya: Strong +1 for an explicit preserve path. Prefer using Object Lock on approved copies and tagging with x-case-id. Legal: COMPLIANCE vs GOVERNANCE? We need wording.
Leo: KMS guidance: envelope encryption with CMK. No long-lived decrypt keys. Create per-request, timeboxed KMS grants tied to ticket id and approver. CloudTrail will record GrantCreate/Decrypt.
Quinn: For partners: keep a masked partner-view 365d; raw is 90d. Nightly pipeline writes both. Partner bucket uses partner CMK + cross-account role.
Maya: Operational sketch:
1) Open ticket (SEC-6xxx) with case_id + justification.
2) On approval, controller copies objects to forensics-archive, tags x-case-id, applies Object Lock (GOVERNANCE default).
3) For unwraps, controller creates a short-lived KMS grant, mints a timeboxed presigned URL via SSO-proxy, and records audit entries.
Priya: Also require Privacy signoff for scrub rules and Finance signoff for storage/KMS costs before finalizing retention.
Leo: Audit pattern: CloudTrail KMS entries + S3 logs + internal security-index entry. Example audit index line (string):
{"ts":"2026-05-01T10:12:00Z","event":"snapshot_unwrap","case_id":"CASE-2026-700","requester":"leo","approver":"priya","grant_id":"g-1a2b3c","object":"forensics/CASE-2026-700-20260430.tar.gz","ticket":"SEC-6001"}
Quinn: Test plan: staging expiry deny -> create object ttl=12s, wait 15s expect OPA deny/403; approval path -> copy to locked bucket, create grant, download -> assert CloudTrail + security-index entries. Also add reconcile job to detect drift.
